# configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf:
# Based on the layout used by Nginx Proxy Manager
pid /tmp/npm-nginx.pid;
error_log /dev/stderr warn;
events { worker_connections 1024; }
http {
  default_type  application/octet-stream;
  include       mime.types;
  sendfile on;
  proxy_cache_path /tmp/npm-cache levels=1:2 keys_zone=public-cache:30m max_size=192m;
  map $host $forward_scheme { default http; }
  # Real IP Determination
  real_ip_header X-Real-IP;
  set_real_ip_from 10.0.0.0/8;
  include conf.d/include/ip_ranges.conf;
  include /data/nginx/default_host/*.conf;
  include /data/nginx/proxy_host/*.conf;
  include /data/nginx/redirection_host/*.conf;
  include /data/nginx/dead_host/*.conf;
}

# configuration file /tmp/gately-audit/impl/tutorials/npm/conf.d/include/ip_ranges.conf:
# Cloudflare ranges (sample)
set_real_ip_from 173.245.48.0/20;

# configuration file /data/nginx/proxy_host/1.conf:
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# nas.example.com
# ------------------------------------------------------------

map $scheme $hsts_header {
    https   "max-age=63072000; preload";
}

server {
  set $forward_scheme http;
  set $server         "192.168.1.10";
  set $port           5000;

  listen 80;
  listen [::]:80;
  listen 443 ssl;
  listen [::]:443 ssl;

  server_name nas.example.com;
  http2 on;

  # Let's Encrypt SSL
  include conf.d/include/letsencrypt-acme-challenge.conf;
  include conf.d/include/ssl-cache.conf;
  include conf.d/include/ssl-ciphers.conf;
  ssl_certificate /etc/letsencrypt/live/npm-1/fullchain.pem;
  ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/npm-1/privkey.pem;

  # Block Exploits
  include conf.d/include/block-exploits.conf;

  # Force SSL
  include conf.d/include/force-ssl.conf;

  # HSTS (ngx_http_headers_module is required) (63072000 seconds = 2 years)
  add_header Strict-Transport-Security $hsts_header always;

  proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
  proxy_set_header Connection $http_connection;
  proxy_http_version 1.1;

  access_log /data/logs/proxy-host-1_access.log;
  error_log /data/logs/proxy-host-1_error.log warn;

  location / {
    # Proxy!
    include conf.d/include/proxy.conf;
  }

  # Custom
  include /data/nginx/custom/server_proxy[.]conf;
}

# configuration file /tmp/gately-audit/impl/tutorials/npm/conf.d/include/letsencrypt-acme-challenge.conf:


# configuration file /tmp/gately-audit/impl/tutorials/npm/conf.d/include/ssl-cache.conf:
ssl_session_cache shared:SSL:50m;

# configuration file /tmp/gately-audit/impl/tutorials/npm/conf.d/include/ssl-ciphers.conf:
ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;

# configuration file /tmp/gately-audit/impl/tutorials/npm/conf.d/include/block-exploits.conf:
## Block SQL injections
set $block_sql_injections 0;
if ($query_string ~ "union.*select.*\(") { set $block_sql_injections 1; }
if ($block_sql_injections = 1) { return 403; }

# configuration file /tmp/gately-audit/impl/tutorials/npm/conf.d/include/force-ssl.conf:
# Force SSL
set $trust_forwarded_proto "F";
if ($scheme = "http") { return 301 https://$host$request_uri; }

# configuration file /tmp/gately-audit/impl/tutorials/npm/conf.d/include/proxy.conf:
add_header       X-Served-By $host;
proxy_set_header Host $host;
proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Scheme $scheme;
proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto  $scheme;
proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For    $remote_addr;
proxy_set_header X-Real-IP          $remote_addr;
proxy_pass       $forward_scheme://$server:$port$request_uri;

# configuration file /data/nginx/proxy_host/2.conf:
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# photos.example.com
# ------------------------------------------------------------

server {
  set $forward_scheme http;
  set $server         "192.168.1.11";
  set $port           2283;

  listen 80;
  listen [::]:80;
  listen 443 ssl;
  listen [::]:443 ssl;

  server_name photos.example.com;
  http2 on;

  ssl_certificate /etc/letsencrypt/live/npm-1/fullchain.pem;
  ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/npm-1/privkey.pem;

  include conf.d/include/force-ssl.conf;

  proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
  proxy_set_header Connection $http_connection;
  proxy_http_version 1.1;

  location / {
    include conf.d/include/proxy.conf;
  }
}

# configuration file /data/nginx/redirection_host/3.conf:
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# old.example.com
# ------------------------------------------------------------
server {
  set $forward_scheme https;
  set $server         "nas.example.com";
  set $port           443;

  listen 80;
  listen [::]:80;
  server_name old.example.com;
  include conf.d/include/letsencrypt-acme-challenge.conf;
  location / {
    return 301 $forward_scheme://nas.example.com$request_uri;
  }
}
